135:t_2:18.en:
$$スザク$$
「The people helping the $$黒の騎士団$$ here in $$新日本$$ are just like you.」

135:t_2:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They don't have a $$ユニコーン$$ or a $$ジェニオン$$. But each has a reason to fight, and they're helping us with their minds made up.」

135:t_2:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All I can do is fight alongside them and restore peace as quickly as possible.」

135:t_2:21.en:
$$スザク$$
「Does that answer your concern, $$バナージ$$?」

135:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...After the 《$$新世時空震動$$》, I... read quite a bit of material about $$ＡＤＷ$$, but...」

135:t_2:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're a little different from the $$ゼロ$$ the public knows.」

135:t_2:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I admit that I deliberately acted theatrically, as those accounts describe...」

135:t_2:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But at least for now, I seek only victory, simply, without doing anything unnecessary.」

135:t_2:27.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes. I'm grateful to everyone in 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

135:t_2:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and I are just like you.」

135:t_2:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm sorry, Mr. $$ゼロ$$... I seem to have misunderstood you based on my impressions alone.」

135:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's no need for an honorific. As long as I wear this mask, I am no individual, merely the symbol called $$ゼロ$$.」

135:t_2:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And that symbol gathers people's hopes and leads them to victory.」

135:t_2:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you mean a vessel...?」

135:t_2:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I take pride in being different from $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

135:t_2:34.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think you are, too.」

135:t_2:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You felt rather distant during the $$時獄戦役$$, but talking with you like this makes me feel closer to you.」

135:t_2:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Perhaps that's because your perceptions have grown sharper.」

135:t_2:37.en:
$n
「Do you mean he's a $$ニュータイプ$$...?」

135:t_2:38.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Captain $$アムロ$$ told me that too. When I draw out the $$ユニコーン$$'s power, it expands my consciousness in return...」

135:t_2:39.en:
$$スザク$$
「It's like $$刹那$$'s $$ダブルオーライザー$$.」

135:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ＧＮ粒子$$, the $$ゼロシステム$$, the $$サイコ・フレーム$$... These machines make humanity evolve...」

135:t_2:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's like our ancestors creating civilization once they acquired fire...」

135:t_2:44.en:
$n
「The blood of the beast, the mingling of waters, the destination of the wind, the civilization of fire... And the radiance of the sun...」

135:t_2:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We heard those words several times during the $$時獄戦役$$...」

135:t_2:46.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バナージ$$... You were uncomfortable with civilians fighting, but...」

135:t_2:47.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Perhaps in our current situation, the distinction between soldiers and civilians no longer matters...」

135:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Wars are fought between soldiers... But in a struggle for survival, every living being is involved.」

135:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Forget it. I just voiced a vague feeling without thinking it through.」

135:t_2:52.en:
$n
(Does $$ゼロ$$... feel the same kind of anxiety that Ms. $$スズネ$$ and I do...?)

135:t_2:55.en:
$$玉城$$
「We just got word! A huge Imperial force is approaching $$カンサイ$$!」

135:t_2:58.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by the way he spoke, that isn't possible.」

135:t_2:60.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's only one possibility... Someone with greater authority than $$ギルター$$ used him as bait.」

135:t_2:62.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$玉城$$! Issue an emergency recall to everyone in $c! We're heading for $$カンサイ$$ too!」

135:t_2:65.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's all right. I've stationed them at $$厳島$$.」

135:t_2:66.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They'll get the job done... For now, let's believe in them.」

135:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems you're all busy intercepting $$サイデリアル$$.」

135:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll help too, as a dimensional merchant... I'll provide the $$サーペント$$s I stocked up on free of charge.」

135:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business today too! So let's get fired up... Business, business!」

135:t_10:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're right. When I sharpen my senses, I can feel something like that.」

135:t_10:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I need a little more time to gather my thoughts.」

135:t_10:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're unusually hesitant. But I have no choice but to leave this to you.」

135:t_10:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The dimensional merchant, $$ＡＧ$$... If that man holds the answer to your question...」

135:t_10:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Uncovering his true identity will have a major bearing on this world's future...」

136:t_000:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Every unit is in position, correct?」

136:t_000:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I understand we're trying to lull the enemy into complacency, but aren't we far too few...?」

136:t_000:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I simply thought you could do it.」

136:t_000:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm not naive enough to fall for flattery like that.」

136:t_000:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$扇$$ or $$玉城$$ might have fallen for it hook, line, and sinker.」

136:t_000:5.en:
$$玉城$$
「Hey, you! I can hear you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!」

136:t_000:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Good work, $$玉城$$. How did it go?」

136:t_000:7.en:
$$玉城$$
「Heh heh... Perfectly. Trust the skills of the great chief of the $$新日本$$ Volunteer Army's engineering corps.」

136:t_000:9.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Work like that seems to suit him better than running a cafe.」

136:t_000:10.en:
$$玉城$$
「It's not that, but if $$ゼロ$$ himself is rising up, I can't keep quiet as his very best friend.」

136:t_000:11.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「He's upgraded himself even beyond best friend...」

136:t_000:12.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, the Volunteer Army plays a big part in $$新日本$$ being able to fight like this now.」

136:t_000:13.en:
$$トロワ$$
「And it's $$ゼロ$$ and the $$黒の騎士団$$ who unite their hearts.」

136:t_000:14.en:
$$カトル$$
「The people of this country remember the days when they fought alongside $$ゼロ$$ and won.」

136:t_000:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At the same time, they know the pain of having things taken from them.」

136:t_000:16.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's why they'll fight to the very end, with their pride.」
